page.title: Create Your Team
page.subtitle: Design your team identity and enter the ProPeloton world.

jersey.title: Team Jersey
jersey.description: Choose one jersey to unlock team creation. You can change it later in Customize Team.
jersey.required: Jersey selection is required before you can create your team.

preview.title: Team Preview
preview.description: Interior layout and colors update live.

patterns.title: Interior Style
patterns.description: Choose how the primary and secondary colors are divided.
patterns.customDescription: Interior Style applies only to the generated team badge.

logo.title: Team Logo
logo.description: Optional. Upload a logo or use an image URL. If none is selected, the generated badge above will be used.
logo.fileHelp: PNG, JPEG/JPG or BMP · maximum 2 MB.

errors.invalidType: Logo must be a PNG, JPEG/JPG, or BMP image.
errors.tooLarge: Logo file must be 2 MB or smaller.
errors.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid logo URL.
errors.httpUrl: Logo URL must start with http:// or https://.
errors.loadUrl: Could not load the logo from this URL.
errors.jerseyRequired: Please choose a team jersey before creating your team.
errors.signIn: You must be signed in to create a team.
errors.bucketMissing: Storage bucket "club-logos" was not found. Please create it in Supabase Storage first.
